description: High Risk Credit Card Input Example
risk_factors: Very high credit utilization (bills near credit limit)
Multiple months of late payments (2-3 months overdue)
Low payment amounts relative to bills

explanation.utilization: Bills are 85-97% of credit limit (very high utilization)
explanation.payment_status: PAY_0=2 means 2 months overdue for current month, PAY_2=3 means 3 months overdue, showing severe payment delays
explanation.payment_amounts: Payments (1,000-5,000) are much lower than bills (170,000-195,000), indicating inability to pay down debt
explanation.trend: Bills are increasing over time (170k -> 195k), showing growing debt
explanation.expected_result: This input should result in a high default probability (>0.7 or 70%+)
